items.html: And this is what I heard from my master, may his memory be blessed, regarding this matter, and it is: know that we explained at first that the nine original Sefirot, together with the RDL"A, are the ten original and fundamental Sefirot of all of Atzilut. But the matter of the existence of the Sefira of Malchut has not yet been revealed now; however, we shall explain first of all this RDL"A. And in this you will understand the greatness of Malchut, that she is a crown on the head of the righteous, and was the head of the corner, and in the future her light will be greater than the sun. And understand this.
